title: Final Energy Extraction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the energy extracted from the temperature difference, W = 1.42 J.

title: Final Gravitational Work
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the work retrieved from the falling water, W' = 1.08 J.

title: Efficiency Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the Carnot efficiency formula and apply it correctly in the context of the problem.

title: Energy Comparison
description: Important Criteria: The student must compare the two energy extraction methods and conclude that W > W'.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the efficiency or energy calculations.

title: Temperature Assumptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must correctly assume the temperatures used in the Carnot efficiency calculation are appropriate for the problem.
